top_signals.title: AI agent disputes head to ‘Internet Court’ — and a jury of AI agents
top_signals.summary: Who better to judge a dispute between AI agents than a jury of different AI models? That’s the idea behind GenLayer, which is already issuing thousands of judgements each day.
